title: KMP Pattern Search
description:
Return every start index where `pattern` occurs in `text`, in increasing order, using the KMP failure function. Occurrences may overlap.

**Constraints**

- `1 <= text.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= pattern.length <= text.length`
- Lowercase English letters
hints: The failure function stores, for each prefix, the length of its longest proper prefix that is also a suffix.
On a mismatch, fall back through that table instead of restarting the scan.

editorial.explanation:
The failure function stores, for each prefix of the pattern, the length of its longest proper prefix
that is also a suffix.

On a mismatch, that table says how far the pattern can slide without missing an occurrence, so the
text pointer never moves backwards. On a full match, falling back through the table is what allows
overlapping matches.

Building the table is `O(m)`, scanning is `O(n)`.
